digest.component_or_area: ADR documentation and module docstring citations
propositions: The f449 ticket description incorrectly cites ADR 0037 for unbounded Jira DC reindex behavior, but ADR 0037 is actually the OSS-contribution-intake-posture ADR.

The correct ADR citations are ADR 0085 §3 ('Eventual-consistency discipline for live probes') for the unbounded search-index-lag rule and ADR 0055 (specifically the 'Search-index lag' row around line 282) for the Jira-family sub-seam context.
The snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py module docstring contains stale ADR 0037 s3 citations that must be replaced with references to ADR 0085 §3 and ADR 0055.
A repo-wide grep reveals stale ADR 0037 references to Jira DC reindex in out-of-scope files (test modules) that should be catalogued but not fixed in this ticket.
